title: Precision regression runner with query-weighted golden sets and adaptive gates
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated regression harness that validates quantized model builds (FP8/INT8) against a query-weighted golden prompt corpus and adaptive pass/fail gates. The runner should: 1) sample and weight golden prompts by real query frequency and customer segments, 2) execute deterministic runs with seeded RNG and KV-cache replay where applicable, 3) compute a set of unit and semantic metrics (token-delta, top-k match, embedding cosine, hallucination heuristics), 4) apply adaptive gates that can tighten or loosen thresholds based on expected model drift and prompt difficulty, and 5) produce machine-readable pass/fail artifacts and a human readable dashboard for triage. This ticket implements the harness orchestration, metric aggregation, and gate evaluation logic (not the dashboard UI).
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run end-to-end on CI and as a scheduled K8s batch job and finish within the configured timeout (default 30m for 2k goldens)
Weighted golden sampling reproduces expected distribution within 5% of target query frequency for each customer segment
Primary gate: mean embedding cosine against baseline >= 0.995 for FP8 and >= 0.997 for INT8 (configurable per model)
Secondary gate: top-1 exact-match drop <= 0.5% and token-level avg delta <= 0.8 tokens compared to float32 baseline
Tertiary gate: hallucination rate increase <= 1.0 percentage point measured by heuristic scorer
If any gate fails, harness emits JSON artifact with failing prompt ids, metric deltas, and suggested rollback tag; CI job should be marked failed
Deterministic replay: repeated execution with same seed and same model artifact must produce identical metric results
Integration tests cover at least one FP8 and one INT8 quantized build and the float32 baseline
technical_notes: Harness design: orchestrator service will spawn parallel workers that execute prompts in shards and stream per-prompt traces to a central aggregator. Each worker runs the same runtime container used in CI; we expose a lightweight replay shim to feed KV cache snapshots for context-heavy prompts. Metrics computed: token-level delta, top-k distribution shift, embedding cosine (OpenAI-embedding-compatible baseline), perplexity delta, and a custom hallucination heuristic based on entity hallucination + factuality checks. Gate evaluation supports adaptive thresholds using moving-window historical variance and prompt difficulty buckets (low/medium/high). Artifacts are persisted to S3 with a standardized key and linked in the PR/CI output. Failure outputs include an 'investigate' bundle with 100 highest-delta prompts and model state hashes. The harness includes a mode to run adversarial perturbations (synonym swaps, prompt-ordering) for robustness checks. Performance: aim to keep per-prompt overhead <50ms beyond inference time by batching and async telemetry flushes.
runbook: On gate failure: 1) Triage automated failure artifact; look at highest-delta prompts and embedding cosines. 2) If the drift is localized to a small prompt subset, file ENG sub-issue and tag model-owner. 3) If widespread, stop the rollout and rollback to previous artifact; follow release rollback runbook. 4) Run adversarial perturbation mode to test sensitivity and attach results to the incident. 5) Postmortem: capture root cause (quantization config, kernel mismatch, dataset shift) and propose corrective action (reline quant config, retrain calibration, or pin runtime kernels).
updates: 2025-01-28: Ticket created after spike showed embedding cosine variance across segments; initial design drafted.
2025-02-03: Spike results: FP8 sample had mean cosine 0.9962 vs baseline, but a 0.9% top1 drop on long-form prompts. Decided to weight goldens by query frequency and include long-form stratification.
2025-02-12: Implemented sampling module and deterministic seed plumbing. Added KV-cache replay shim; unit tests for seed determinism added.

2025-02-20: First end-to-end run against a FP8 candidate: harness completed but triggered secondary gate due to token_delta on 42 prompts. Captured investigate bundle and created ENG-85220 to triage the prompts.
2025-02-26: Code review feedback addressed: reduced memory footprint of aggregator, added adaptive threshold primitive and config schema. Updated acceptance thresholds to be model-configurable.

2025-03-05: INT8 run failing embedding gate on one customer segment—investigating kernel selection differences. Reproduced locally and linked debug logs to PR #184. Next: add deterministic kernel pinning flag and re-run.
